response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and some high-throughput backend work, plus strong evidence of mentoring through workshops, courses and open-source leadership. However, the role's central hard requirement — 8 years of C++ — is not met; his documented C/C++ exposure is roughly six months at National Instruments plus a university thesis project, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js and D. Likewise, there is no evidence of building or leading a large-scale cloud compute platform, and no formal technical leadership title. The gap between his profile and the core C++/infrastructure-platform requirements is too large to justify an interview for this specific opening.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering track record across systems, backend and embedded
Demonstrated mentoring: workshops, courses, conference talks, open-source projects
Low-latency, high-throughput microservices experience at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months professional)
No large-scale cloud compute platform or infrastructure ownership evidence
No formal technical leadership role or team-level project management history
